set.body:
Implement the optional controller and gateway contract in WP-16. Bind authorized approval to exact release, artifact, destination, audience, settings and expiry. Atomically record intent and work. Fence exposure with desired state and current authority. Assert on a controllable target that response loss, competing generations, expiry, withdrawal, policy outage and restore cannot expose an obsolete artifact or advance observed state prematurely. Recovery from an older snapshot requires independently current intent or fresh approval.

Source: docs/implementation-plan.md, External discovery through Neurobagel.
set.title: NB02: Bind publication approval and withdrawal to target generations
